title: Tests that create experiments must pass a tmp_path artifact_location
answers: test experiment artifacts written to repo-root mlruns directory
xdist test run races with mlruns cleanup
flaky artifacts from tests creating experiments without artifact location
isolate test experiment artifact path to tmp_path
body:
Symptom: Parallel test runs leave run artifacts in the shared repo-root mlruns/ folder, and cleanup races with them, so artifact tests fail intermittently.
Root cause: Experiments created without an explicit artifact_location fall back to the default ./mlruns location (tests/tracking/test_client.py:test_log_model_artifact and tests/tracking/fluent/test_fluent.py:test_create_external_model both called create_experiment with no location).
Fix pattern: Pass artifact_location=(tmp_path / "exp-artifacts").as_uri() to every create_experiment call a test makes, so artifacts go under that test's tmp_path.
Constraints: Applies to tests that create experiments through mlflow.create_experiment or MlflowClient.create_experiment. Does not cover tests that only read existing experiments.
applies: Test code under tests/ that creates experiments.
says: Parallel test runs intermittently fail due to conflicting experiment artifact folders.
Leftover experiment run artifacts pollute the workspace after running automated tests.
Isolate artifact storage paths whenever tests create new tracking experiments.
search: Tests creating experiments via mlflow.create_experiment or MlflowClient.create_experiment must pass an explicit artifact_location using tmp_path. Omitting artifact_location defaults to the shared repo-root mlruns/ directory, causing race conditions and flaky artifact failures during parallel test runs. Tests should pass artifact_location=(tmp_path / 'exp-artifacts').as_uri(); tests only reading existing experiments are exempt.
